purpose: Keep MARKET+OUTSIDER as the TRIO probability engine and directly attenuate tickets containing upper-ranked horses warned by Structural Risk.

correction.formula: p_corrected(ticket) proportional to p_outsider(ticket) * exp(-lambda * warned_upper_horses_in_ticket)
correction.selection: Choose scope, warning mode, and lambda only from prior out-of-sample races.

structural_risk.warm_2022: On eligible 2022 races: first 60% trains Structural Risk, middle 20% unused, last 20% produces OOF warnings used for the first correction-policy selection.
structural_risk.positive_warning: signed Structural Risk delta >= training-fold p80
structural_risk.absolute_warning: absolute Structural Risk delta >= training-fold p80
structural_risk.top_scope: Union of Seven-King and market upper ranks.

evaluation.primary: race logloss delta versus pure TRIO market

success_gate.strong: bootstrap 95% CI for corrected-minus-Outsider entirely below zero
